    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static boolean[] bio = new boolean[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long sol = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                sol = (sol * p) % MOD;
            }
        } else {
            long inv = 1;
            while ((inv * k) % p != 1) {
                inv++;
            }

            if (k == 1) {
                sol = p;
            }

            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                if (!bio[i]) {
                    sol = (sol * p) % MOD;
                    long j = i;
                    while (!bio[(int)j]) {
                        bio[(int)j] = true;
                        j = (j * inv) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(sol);
        sc.close();
    }
}
